mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user (user_id, user_pw, user_name, user_gender, user_age, user_region, joined_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{pw}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{date}, #{region}, #{time})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS id, user_pw AS pw, user_name AS name, user_gender AS gender, user_age AS date, user_region AS region, joined_at AS time FROM tb_user WHERE user_id = #{id} AND user_pw = #{pw}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_party (party_nm, party_info, party_region, party_file, created_at, user_id) VALUES (#{partyNm}, #{partyInfo}, #{partyRegion}, #{partyFile}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT p.party_idx, p.party_nm, p.party_info, p.party_region, p.party_file, p.created_at, p.user_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_joining j WHERE j.party_idx = p.party_idx) AS member_count, u.user_name AS creator_name FROM tb_party p LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.party_region = #{region}

SELECT p.party_idx, p.party_nm, p.party_info, p.party_region, p.created_at, p.user_id AS ownerId, j.joined_at FROM tb_party p JOIN tb_joining j ON p.party_idx = j.party_idx WHERE j.user_id = #{userId} AND j.agree_yn = 'Y'
SELECT * FROM tb_joining WHERE party_idx = #{partyIdx} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_joining (party_idx, user_id, join_intro, agree_yn, joined_at) VALUES (#{partyIdx}, #{userId}, #{joinIntro}, 'N', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT j.join_idx, j.party_idx, j.user_id, j.join_intro, u.user_name FROM tb_joining j LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON j.user_id = u.user_id WHERE j.party_idx = #{partyIdx} AND j.agree_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_party_post (p_post_nm, p_post_content, p_post_file, p_post_views, p_post_like, created_at, user_id, party_idx) VALUES (#{postNm}, #{postContent}, #{postFile}, 0, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userId}, #{partyIdx})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_party_post WHERE party_idx = #{partyIdx} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_party_comment (p_post_idx, p_cmt_content, created_at, user_id) VALUES (#{postIdx}, #{content}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_party_comment WHERE p_post_idx = #{postIdx} ORDER BY created_at ASC
